name: amoo-live
description: Claude Code only, experimental: a live pane mirroring the device amoo drives, with the session's recent actions, a status line and toasts on failed assertions. Requires the amoo CLI and MCP server.

amooPath.title: amoo executable
amooPath.description: Name or absolute path of the amoo CLI that runs `amoo device stream` for the mirror.

fps.title: Mirror frames per second
fps.description: Frames per second to aim for, 0.1 to 30. Capture speed caps it at about 3 on simulators and emulators.
